# Brand Archetype Quiz
Date: 2026-10-20 | Duration: 35m

## Summary
The group selected Archetype C as a flexible starting point while noting that it should evolve to include leadership, humor, humanity, and community. The desired brand direction emphasizes experimentation leadership, confidence, openness, transparency, accessible knowledge, and an approachable personality. Google was viewed as the closest overall brand fit, while Dyson represented expert craftsmanship and focused problem-solving, though neither fully captured the desired identity. “Knowledge is power” led the tagline discussion, with “Imagination is the only limit” remaining an alternative. The positioning should present the company as a trusted partner for successful experimentation programs, differentiated through expertise, knowledge sharing, culture, flexibility, and integrations. Lyndsie Berens will consolidate materials and summarize the discussion in Slack; Graham McNicoll will provide the founding story; Elyse Fox and Scott Bailey will work on target audiences; and the visual identity will be completed collaboratively. The document will be reviewed and delivered to the branding team by Friday ahead of Monday’s kickoff, and Ashley Stirrup will complete the interview form.

## Keywords
Brand archetype, Experimentation leadership, Thought leadership, Brand positioning, Customer trust, Visual identity
